# PHASE 5 — RTL/LTR Report

## Files Inspected
- `search.component.scss`
- `reports-list.component.scss`
- `report-viewer.component.scss`
- `notifications.component.scss`

## Issues Found & Fixed

### search.component.scss — 2 Fixes Applied
**Issue 1:** `.search-bar__icon` used `margin-right: 12px`
- In RTL mode, the search icon is on the wrong (right) side of the input
- Fix: Changed to `margin-inline-end: 12px` (CSS logical property — automatically flips in RTL)

**Issue 2:** Responsive override at 360px breakpoint also used `margin-right: 8px`
- Fix: Changed to `margin-inline-end: 8px`

### notifications.component.scss — Already Fixed (Phase 2)
- `:host-context([dir="rtl"]) .notif-item--unread` already present and correct

### reports-list.component.scss — No Issues Found
- No physical directional properties causing RTL layout breaks
- `text-align: center` is symmetric and safe

### report-viewer.component.scss — Assessed, Not Modified
- `right: -100px` is on a decorative background element — does not affect functionality
- `padding-left: 24px` and `border-left: 3px` on `.report-content blockquote` — these are inside report HTML content rendered via `[innerHTML]`. The report content is AI-generated and is not a UI element subject to RTL flipping. Not modified.
- `text-align: left` on `th` — inside AI-generated report content table. Not a UI label. Not modified.
